# <Component> — Component Design Description

## Responsibility and boundaries

Describe the component's purpose, responsibilities, exclusions, and relationship to the SADD. Link to the parent SADD.

## Package mapping

Map the logical component to implementing Rust crates and Python packages, including responsibilities across language boundaries. Identify planned packages explicitly.

## Internal structure

Describe major internal parts, their responsibilities, and relationships at a high level.

## Interfaces and dependencies

Describe provided and consumed interfaces, allowed dependencies, and links to canonical shared contracts.

## Data flow and lifecycle

Describe the main flows, state ownership, initialization, operation, and shutdown where applicable.

## Design constraints and rationale

Describe applicable system constraints and tradeoffs. Link to ADRs for consequential choices.

## Detailed specifications

Link to behavior specs and shared contracts. Keep detailed acceptance criteria in those documents.

## Open questions

Identify unresolved choices and their impact. If superseded, identify the replacement.
